verdict.rationale: Coinbase x402 is an HTTP payment protocol and hosted facilitator, not an agent or host application that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error. The evidence only shows a first-party Bazaar MCP server that agents can connect to. That is the server role, which belongs to a different story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
